newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko Sec not involved in illegal deals -- affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Sec not involved in illegal deals -- affiliate.

text.p: Nikko Securities Investment Trust and Management Co said on Wednesday that Nikko Securities Co Ltd was not involved in illegal bond deals Nikko Securities Investment Trust conducted in 1994.

"We did not conduct the deals with Nikko (Securities Co). The deals were between us and a securities house which is not one of the Big Four brokerages," an official of Nikko Securities Investment Trust said. He declined to comment further.
The Big Four are Nomura Securities Co Ltd, Daiwa Securities Co Ltd, Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd and Nikko Securities.
Nikko Securities Investment Trust is five-percent owned by Nikko Securities, the official said.
It said earlier that it had conducted illegal bond trading for which it expected the Ministry of Finance (MOF) to impose penalties by the end of the week.
The affiliate said that it asked a securities firm to buy Euroyen bonds at prices 2.3 billion yen higher than their market prices in 1994 to secure funds to repay investors.
In return, the affiliate bought different Euroyen bonds from the securities firm at a later date at prices which were 2.5 billion yen higher than market prices.
"They were the only illegal deals we made. We did not repeat such deals," the official with the affiliate said.
Nikko Securities Investment Trust expects MOF to suspend it from setting up new funds for a certain period of time as a punishment, the official said.
